**Meridian Tidal Pilot - Final Operations Review Summary**

Turbine T-4 suffered a bearing seal failure on 14 March 2025 when the bearing seal corroded through, allowing seawater into the nacelle. The root cause was traced to corrosion of the bearing seal housing, causing a multi-week outage.

Over 24 months, the pilot delivered 18.7 GWh to the grid, which was 6% below the 19.9 GWh forecast.

The project cost EUR 41.25 million against an approved budget of EUR 36.7 million—a 12.4% overrun (EUR 4.55 million) primarily driven by the T-4 repair campaign.

Environmentally, independent fish-monitoring found no statistically significant change in migration counts before and after installation (p = 0.41).

Lead engineer Dr. Ines Marchetti recommended replacing titanium fasteners with duplex stainless steel on all remaining nacelles, which the steering group accepted in principle.

**Decision:** The steering group approved Phase 2 for Q3 2026, contingent on completing the bearing seal redesign and a successful dry-dock endurance test.
